title: No damages in absence of breach.
bodyText: Absent a breach of trust, a trustee shall not be liable to a beneficiary for a loss or depreciation in the value of trust property or for not having made a profit.
bodyHtml: [§554D-1003]  No damages in absence of breach.  Absent a breach of trust, a trustee shall not be liable to a beneficiary for a loss or depreciation in the value of trust property or for not having made a profit. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
